# Product and research policy preparation result

Status: **candidate and unissued policy set; no real participant processing, monitoring or employment-use authority**.

The [policy inventory](../../model/policies/README.md) maps fourteen needed policy domains to the Lab's currently selected Policy/v2 carrier. These cover purpose/notice, retention, assistance, administration, accessibility, case release, scoring/feedback, research recruitment, research use/export/training, access/incident, vendors, rights, claims/employment use and integration reconsideration. Their 46 [source-bound clauses](../../model/policies/index.json) specify condition, required or prohibited effect, enforcement point, evidence, exception route, owner and open parameters. Lab Policy/v2 records reference those clauses; none is issued.

One new project-scoped [Policy Clause definition](../../model/definitions.json) and its local candidate Artifact Type Request carry individual rules. The pre-existing Retention Schedule meaning now has a candidate [ten-class schedule](../../model/policies/retention-schedule.json) and type request; all durations, jurisdiction, controller and approval are unset. A new Assistance Permission Matrix meaning has a [24-row candidate matrix](../../model/policies/assistance-matrix.json) and type request for three sessions. It proposes notes and accessibility aids while disallowing live external help in a baseline; E09 research arms are separately assigned and disclosed. These values require owner review and participant-facing publication before scored use.

The [primary-source review](../../model/policies/EVIDENCE-REVIEW.md) checks research/privacy guidance, data rights and incidents, accessibility, AI governance and potential employment selection concerns without assuming one jurisdiction applies. The [gap register](../../model/carriers/gaps.json) leaves owner principals, basis, durations, assistance adoption, protocols, thresholds, processor terms, operational tests and issue Decisions open. Specialized Administration, Recovery, Access and Decision policies retain their own meaning and must be reconciled before activation.

Current [carrier coverage](../../model/carriers/coverage.json): 167 selected Lab carrier candidate records, 208 local candidate records, 22 Artifact Type Requests and 17 explicit gaps. [Policy validation](../../tools/validate_policy_records.py) and selected Lab schema checks prove source and shape consistency only. A [fresh exact Lab review cut](../../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/proposals/engineer-assessment-research/2026-10-26/policy-governance-v1/manifest.json) pins the proposal for owner inspection.
